description: Chamomile is a truly amazing plant species. Its delicate, daisy-like flowers have been used for centuries to make a soothing medicinal tea. The plant is also known for its calming properties; the tea can be used to help reduce anxiety, insomnia and even mild depression. Thanks to its low-growing nature, its a great addition to any garden. Its drought tolerant and making it a great choice for busy gardeners who want something that will thrive without a lot of maintenance. Plus, its sweet aroma will bring a lovely scent to any outdoor area. Chamomile truly is an amazing plant species.
